description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {R}{R}.
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {R}.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the Pyretic Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Pyretic Ritual.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Reiterate.
Resolve the Reiterate copy, creating a copy of Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the second Pyretic Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the first copy of Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.
